doc: The game's perks: what a perk on an item grants. Its value (the number its tooltip shows), the armour and the damage bonus of the simple perks.

ids.rule: The stable name starts as the perk's debug name in lower case (Perk_Damage_Ice is game:perk_damage_ice), the same ids items.perks holds. A perk without a debug name is game:perk_<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>. When two perks would get the same name, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is game:<name>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>.

value.doc: The amount the perk grants, the number its tooltip shows (a share as a fraction where the tooltip shows a percentage; below 0 for a perk that lowers something, such as a cost). A perk's effect reads it when it starts: equipping the item, unlocking the perk. A perk whose game value is a whole number takes whole numbers only (a fraction is refused, never rounded). The simple armour and damage perks have none.

armor.doc: The armour the perk adds, as a share of the item's armour per kind. Read whenever the wearer's armour is computed.

enabled.doc: The perk adds armour (only the simple armour perks do in the game).
